name: Noise and Hearing
summary: Sound, not sight, is what draws the enemy: they walk to where the noise was, not to where you are.
description: A hub broadcasts a noise at a point with a radius; every listener inside it remembers that position and goes to look. Because the memory is a place rather than a target, running away works, throwing something works, and standing still works — which is the whole reason stealth is interesting. Includes a drop-in investigator AI with a sight cone you can slip behind, wander, chase and a wall-sliding unstick, all inside the shared scripting contract so it runs on both engines.
nextSteps: Put NoiseDirector.js on one manager actor and tag it Director.
Put NoiseInvestigator.js on anything that should hear, and tag those actors Enemy.
Call emitNoise(x, y, radius) on the director whenever the player does something audible — footsteps on a timer, and every hit, shot or door.
